name: incendios-madrid
description: Mapa en tiempo casi real de focos de calor (NASA FIRMS) y perímetros de área quemada (EFFIS) en España y Portugal

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.preview:cf: npm run build -w client && wrangler pages dev client/dist
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && tsc -p functions --noEmit
